title: Handback line
description: The one final line a headless dispatcher session prints after the workflow it ran ends: the handback sentinel, a space, then this object as JSON on one line, and nothing after it. The driver reads the line as the dispatch's result. Every field is a fact the composite's return value reports, copied, never a conclusion the session draws: a field the composite did not report is null, never false or true. The orchestrator's own result document (elaboration) is a different contract, orchestrator/core/handback_contract.py.

ok.description: False when the workflow failed. A success is never invented.

stage.description: The phase the workflow ended in; the failing stage when it failed.

detailPath.description: The run journal path the workflow reported, or null.

deployedToDev.description: Copied from the composite's return value (it may sit under its deploy readiness result); null when not reported. A guessed true claims something reached AWS when it may never have.

smokePassed.description: Copied from the composite's return value (it may sit under its deploy readiness result); null when not reported.

settled.description: The settle composite's status, copied; null when not reported.

landingStage.description: Copied from the composite's return value; null when not reported.

prUrl.description: The pull request the composite opened, copied; null when not reported.

settleFailed.description: The composite reports a failed settle as an object carrying the error: true when its `settleFailed` is present at all, null when it is absent.

deployIteration.description: Copied from the composite's return value; null when not reported.

beadsEmitted.description: Copied only when the composite reports it; never inferred or counted. Null otherwise.

requiredHumanActions.description: Each action the composite returned in `requiredHumanActions`, named by its name as a short string: never summarised, counted or merged into the headline, never invented, never attempted by the session. Null when the composite reported none.
